journey: A reader installs the three.ws 3D skills into Claude from three.ws/docs/agent-skills (the Claude Code plugin, or the downloadable zip), asks for a chair, and Claude searches the free asset catalog first; when nothing in the catalog fits, it generates a new textured GLB from the words on the free lane. No account and no API key at any hop.

steps.name: the install guide the post links is live
the Claude Code plugin marketplace the guide installs from is public (no account needed to add it)
the installed plugin carries find-3d-assets, whose trigger tells Claude to check the catalog before generating

expect.contains: Check here BEFORE generating a model from scratch

steps.name: the downloadable 3D skills zip is served with no sign-in
the free catalog the skill searches holds at least 3,500 assets, read with no key
asking the catalog for a chair, exactly as the skill does, returns a free CC0 chair with a downloadable GLB
when nothing fits, the skill's free forge_free call turns words into a finished GLB, with no account or key

arguments.prompt: a small glossy green ceramic frog figurine
